scenario: Regenerate after visiting current default Oakfield (421) then Whitewatch (289); both models remain in the two-town cache.
observation: Two terrain builds: an unnecessary close-view rebuild of the old world while removing Oakfield’s excavation, followed by the required atlas of the replacement world.
rootCause: reset() removed cached models while this.world still referred to the old renderer world. remove() immediately re-seated rivers and refilled excavation terrain for each removed model.
fix: Detach this.world before batch removal. Restore the requested world after cleanup; retain the existing final one-build guard when resetting the same world with open excavations. Standalone remove() remains unchanged.
limitations: 831.8 ms is a single observed discarded rebuild in this diagnostic run, not a promised speedup or performance benchmark.
regressions: clear and different-world resets generate no discarded terrain or rivers
same-world multi-excavation reset restores the ground in exactly one rebuild
single-model eviction still closes its opening immediately
